verdict.rationale: The evidence describes default persistence: sandboxes auto-snapshot their filesystem on stop, and snapshots and drives keep data across runs. Nothing documents a way to delete sandboxes, snapshots or drives, or to set retention periods for stored data. Timeout, stop controls and region selection govern compute lifetime and location, not data retention or deletion, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
